subject: general
question: Which of the following is keyboard shortcut to reload the current page in Google search engine?
solution:
**The correct answer is 2) F5.**

__
 
• In Google search engine, pressing the F5 key on your keyboard is a common keyboard shortcut used to reload the current page.
 
• This is also known as refreshing the page.
 
• Reloading the page can be useful in a number of situations, such as when you want to update the search results or load new content.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• F7: This keyboard shortcut is typically used to activate the spelling and grammar check in many applications, including Microsoft Word and Outlook.
 
• F1: This keyboard shortcut is commonly used to open the Help menu or bring up context-specific help in many applications.
 
• F3: This keyboard shortcut has different functions depending on the application you are using. In some applications, it is used to open a search box or find feature.
 
• In others, it may be used to open the Expose or Task View feature on a Mac or Windows computer.
 
• **In summary, the correct option is 2) F5, which is a keyboard shortcut used to reload the current page in Google search engine.**
